inlines.v: VICTO'RIOUS, adjective 1. Having conquered in battle or contest; having overcome an enemy or antagonist; conquering; vanquishing; as a victorious general; victorious troops; a victorious admiral or navy. 2. That produces conquest; as a victorious day. 3. Emblematic of conquest; indicating victory; as brows bound with victorious wreaths.
